capabilities: Expose REST endpoints under /periodic/{period}/ for daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly notes
Read, create, append, patch, and delete periodic notes, including heading or block targets
Provide an MCP periodic_note_get_path tool that returns and optionally creates the current periodic note's path
Delegate folder, format, template, and creation logic to the Daily Notes and Periodic Notes plugins
Redirect requests to the host's /vault/ endpoint to keep write semantics identical
disambiguation: Not a periodic-notes plugin itself; it only exposes REST endpoints and delegates all note configuration and creation to the Daily Notes and Periodic Notes plugins.
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; a design trade-off note is referenced in src/routes.ts rather than the README itself.
intentEvidence: Adds periodic-note support to Obsidian Local REST API using functionality provided by @liamcaine's Periodic Notes plugin.
problem: Local REST API removed its native periodic-note endpoints, so external tools and MCP clients lack a documented way to read or write periodic notes.

relations.evidence: the same model Local REST API used before its (since-removed) native implementation
using functionality provided by @liamcaine's Periodic Notes plugin
delegates all folder/format/template/creation logic to the core Daily Notes and community Periodic Notes plugins via obsidian-daily-notes-interface

summary: Extension for the Local REST API plugin that adds REST endpoints and an MCP tool for daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly periodic notes.
